description: This file defines a PHP class 'Subscription' that extends a base controller class in the OpenCart system. It contains methods for handling subscription reports, including viewing, listing, saving configuration, and generating report data. The class interacts with models, views, and configuration to provide subscription-related functionalities within the OpenCart admin extension module.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Controller class for managing subscription reports in the OpenCart admin extension.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the subscription report page, loads language, sets up breadcrumbs, and renders the subscription form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves configuration settings for the subscription report if the user has modify permissions, returns success or error as JSON.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates and displays the subscription report, including filtering, pagination, and data formatting.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of subscriptions by calling getReport() and outputs it.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Gathers filter parameters, fetches subscription data from the model, and prepares the report data for display.
